bio_am: Ծնած է Զէյվա (Սիւնիք)՝ 1879-ին։ Վանի ինքնապաշտպանութեան (1915) եւ 1918-ի Արարատեան ազատամարտի ղեկավարը, մահացած է 1919-ին։
bio_en: Aram Manukian, born Sargis Hovhannisian in 1879 in the village of Zeyva in Syunik to a gunsmith's family, was sent by his elder brother to the Shushi diocesan school, where he was a pupil by 1890. In 1900 he was one of fifteen senior students expelled from Karabakh as revolutionaries on the denunciations of Benik vardapet; they finished at the Yerevan diocesan school and became leaders of the ARF's new generation. By 1906 he was a member of the ARF Central Committee of Vaspurakan alongside Vana Ishkhan, Salman and Vana Sargis, and he worked from Karabakh to Van, Constantinople, Ordu and Geneva. Known to the people as Aram Pasha, the hero of the Van self-defence of 1915, he became the central figure of the Ararat struggle in spring 1918 and a leading statesman of the Republic of Armenia; he died in 1919.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high.
